evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior horn.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Diffuse partial thickness chondrosis of the weightbearing aspect of the femoral condyle with some full thickness fissuring along the weightbearing portions of the condyle.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.PF OA: Areas of full-thickness chondrosis involving the medial patellar facet extending to the median eminence.
evidence.Effusion: Small joint effusion with synovial proliferation.
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
